successor.radial_ties: boundary goes to the deeper bin; clamp final depth to 3
successor.selection: fresh conditional channel from the recomputed mathematical softmax row
successor.emission: deterministic branch centre; no Gaussian noise and no nearest-concept projection
successor.probability_record: symbolic product of conditional softmax factors, certified by rational intervals
successor.unresolved_enclosure: NeedsRefinement; never treat an interval containing zero as an exact zero
